primary_pvalue: patient-level permutation of the ALR slope (does not scale with n_cells)
honest_n_note: n is patients/samples. Cells are the compositional library size, not the replicate unit.

fdr.primary_family: BH over patient-permutation ALR tests labeled primary_tacstd2 (TNK/TLS)
fdr.bonferroni_column: bonferroni_primary on the T/NK/B/TLS tacstd2_high ALR-perm grid
fdr.dm_lrt: diagnostic only; not used for FDR (library-size inflated)
